<!-- pr-reviewer: 07d10274a78d88022db9524d7e661b2a6367b71d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes `Face` toolpath generation. The PR is still a draft, so the author or the maintainer must mark it ready before the merge.

## What looks good

- Under `FaceHoles::Lift`, `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:400` reads `standing_at(m_gen, fparams.cut_z)` and rotates the outline into the turned frame of `laid`.
- `crates/app/src/operation/material_source.rs:93` reads `standing_above` 1 um below `cut_z`, so a hole whose rim reaches the cut plane keeps its material ring. When `slice::project` returns an error, `.ok()` returns `None` and `forbidden` lifts over every hole as a safe fallback.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face_holes.rs:129` (`beside`) filters the region voids to holes that `present` touches or approaches within `0.05` mm (`BESIDE`). Bosses inside holes and holes at the cut plane stay whole, and `CutAir` and `Through` do not change.
- I found no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()` outside tests in the diff.
- No goldens, snapshot PNGs, UI files, dependencies, build scripts, workflows, or process files changed.
- `docs/decisions/2437-face-holes-below-cut.md` records the decision, the dropped options, and the follow-up scope (#2657). The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #2437`.

## Results merged with main

All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2666` after a clean trial merge with `upstream/main` (`3a240b7fb`). No GitHub runner was used. Because the local `sccache` server refused connections, the cargo commands ran with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 119 of 119 steps passed (29.3 min).
  - `motion` lib: 444 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored (includes the 3 tests in `machining2d::face_holes::law`).
  - `motion` suites: `center_cut_owed` (7), `face_blend` (8), `face_concave_holes` (3), `face_holes` (7), `tiny_step` (3), `top_z_level` (13), `top_z_stock_over` (2) all passed, 0 failed.
  - `app` lib: 380 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored.
  - `app` suites (108 binaries, including `face_holes_below_cut` 3/3, `face_holes` 3/3, `face_stock_edge` 3/3, `solid_law` 4/4, `solid_law_goldens` 7/7): all passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_part_programs`: 2 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I ran two independent mutations in `.claude/worktrees/review-2666` and reverted each one afterwards:

1. Reverted the `FaceHoles::Lift` arm in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:400` to `_ => None`: `camcraft-app --test face_holes_below_cut` failed 2 of 3 tests (`holes_below_the_cut_plane_are_not_lifted_over` reported 8 plunges instead of 1; `a_face_above_holes_below_the_cut_plane_has_no_gouge_finding` reported 7 `Gouge` findings). Restored the code: 3 passed, 0 failed.
2. Removed `(FaceHoles::Lift, Some(s))` from `forbidden` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face_holes.rs:113`: `camcraft-motion --lib face_holes::law` failed 1 of 3 (`lift_bridges_only_the_holes_that_material_at_the_plane_touches`), and `face_holes_below_cut` failed 2 of 3. Restored the code: both suites passed (3/3 and 3/3).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 3,919 lines (already above the 400-line limit, and grew by 8 lines). `crates/app/src/operation/material_source.rs` is now 399 lines.
- `crates/app/tests/face_holes_below_cut.rs:13` names `standing_above` in its gate map; naming `standing_at` too would match the direct call.
- A hole whose rim reaches the cut plane near an open outer rim still raises a verify finding in `sim::verify::section::tangency` (tracked separately in #2657). The MCP `p01-flange` repro, tilted `Face`, and area-turned `Face` were not exercised separately here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
